property.name: Lifetime
property.summary: Lifetime associated with this ToolHost. The ToolHost manages its binding, lifecycle notifications, and disposal.

method.name: Starting_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Starting lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Starting phase was entered.

field.name: LifeKey
field.summary: Opaque key used for lifecycle notifications and disposal of the bound lifetime.

method.name: AssignLifetimeLogger
method.summary: Assigns this ToolHost's resolved logger to a built-in ToolHostLifetime when applicable.

method.name: DisposeCore
method.summary: Disposes the host-owned resources and lifetime, then always runs base Tool cleanup and aggregates failures.
method.param: True when managed resources should be disposed.

method.name: DisposeAsyncCore
method.summary: Asynchronously disposes host-owned resources, synchronously disposes its lifetime, then always runs base Tool cleanup and aggregates failures.
method.param: True when managed resources should be disposed.

method.name: DisposeHostResources
method.summary: Provides a derived host a hook to dispose resources it owns.

method.name: DisposeHostResourcesAsync
method.summary: Provides a derived host a hook to asynchronously dispose resources it owns.

method.name: Start_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Start lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. Lifecycle state validation and phase completion are delegated to the base implementation.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Start phase completed.

method.name: Started_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Started lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. Notify the host lifetime only after the base phase completes successfully.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Started phase and host notification complete.

method.name: Stopping_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Stopping lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. Notify the host lifetime only after the base phase completes successfully.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Stopping phase and host notification complete.

method.name: Stop_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Stop lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. Lifecycle state validation and phase completion are delegated to the base implementation.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Stop phase completed.

method.name: Stopped_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Stopped lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. Notify the host lifetime only after the base phase completes successfully.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Stopped phase and host notification complete.
